title: Independent DrAgent count audit
visual_locators: PDF p.5 Table II score definitions
correct_threshold: Score >=2, derived from authors' correct/exceptional answer rubric; not the paper's mean-score measure.

Q6_mean_inconsistency.assessment: Printed 1.66 is inconsistent with thirteen 2s and five -1s; the body states the observed question-mean range begins at 1.16.
Q6_mean_inconsistency.recommendation: Use audited correct-case counts rather than the inconsistent printed Q6 mean.

Q6_grading_caveat: Footnote 8 accepts a correct numerical fault duration if the answer explicitly identifies it as duration. Q6 therefore is not exclusively a clearance-timestamp metric.
limits: 18 disturbance-record cases, not 18 repeated stochastic trials per case.
Scores were manually assessed by a domain expert.
Baseline and agent use different prompt/context workflows. The comparison does not isolate one component causally.
Do not describe the Q6 result as 13/18 correct clearance timestamps.
proposed_plot_caption: Correct answers (score >=2), reconstructed from Table IV and Appendix; n=18 DR cases per question. Q6 includes correctly labeled duration under footnote 8. Counts are author-data-derived, not an independent rerun.
